FAQ.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.title: B2B Export & Logistics FAQ
FAQ.desc: Find quick answers regarding our global B2B agricultural sourcing, processing standards, and distribution channels.
FAQ.q1: What quality certifications does Minh Phuong have for export goods?
FAQ.a1: All our facilities and products meet the highest global standards: FDA, BRCGS, IFS Food, ISO 22000, HACCP, HALAL, BSCI, and EU DL200. We regularly export directly to the US, Europe, Japan, and the Middle East.
FAQ.q2: What is the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for export orders?
FAQ.a2: For frozen seafood (IQF/BQF) and frozen tropical fruits, the standard MOQ is 1 x 20ft refrigerated container (FCL). For Robusta coffee beans, the MOQ is 1 x 20ft dry container. We also support consolidated test shipments under special conditions.
FAQ.q3: How does Minh Phuong control food safety and product consistency?
FAQ.a3: We operate a 100% integrated supply chain from farm to port. Every single batch is thoroughly tested for chemical and microbiological residues before sterile packaging at our 5 Kaizen-managed factories and AI-controlled cold storage.
FAQ.q4: Do you offer OEM/ODM packaging services for private label brands?
FAQ.a4: Yes, we provide full OEM/ODM manufacturing and private labeling solutions, including customized multilingual retail bags, vacuum-sealed packaging, and heavy-duty moisture-proof cartons matching your exact market specifications.
